en.hubeali:
And it is reported, 
(It has been narrated) from the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> having said: ‘
Strike it (animal) upon the fleeing, and do not strike it upon the stumbling’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated from the Holy Prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, who has said:
‘You may hit your stumpers for running away in fright but not because of their stumbling.’”
